d: The Senior Auto Electrician is responsible for diagnosing, repairing, maintaining, and troubleshooting electrical and electronic systems in heavy vehicles, construction equipment, and plant machinery. The role ensures vehicles and equipment are maintained in a safe, reliable, and roadworthy condition while complying with company safety and quality standards.
q: Diploma, ITI, or Technical Certificate in Auto Electrical Technology or a related field
Minimum 7-10 years of experience as an Auto Electrician, preferably in heavy vehicles, commercial fleets, or construction equipment
Experience working on trucks, buses, trailers, generators, and heavy construction machinery
Strong knowledge of automotive electrical systems, ECU diagnostics, CAN Bus systems, and fault-finding techniques
Ability to read and interpret electrical diagrams and manufacturer's manuals
r: Understand and comply with the company's Health & Safety Policy, safety procedures, emergency procedures, risk assessments, and safe working practices
Ensure all maintenance and repair activities are carried out in accordance with site safety requirements
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and ensure compliance by colleagues and visitors within the work area
Report all safety incidents, injuries, damage, vehicle accidents, hazards, and near misses to the Workshop Supervisor and Safety Officer
Maintain high standards of housekeeping within the workshop and worksite
Participate in weekly toolbox talks and other safety-related meetings
Undertake all electrical service, maintenance, and repair activities as assigned, ensuring service records are completed accurately
Attend vehicle and equipment breakdowns and perform fault diagnosis and corrective repairs
Diagnose and repair electrical and electronic systems including wiring harnesses, batteries, starters, alternators, sensors, lighting systems, control modules, and CAN Bus systems
Use diagnostic equipment and testing instruments to identify faults and verify repairs
Complete all work safely, efficiently, and within agreed timelines
Ensure vehicles and equipment are handed back in a safe and fully operational condition
Report major defects, recurring faults, or issues that may affect vehicle safety, reliability, or performance
Read and interpret wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, and technical manuals
Carry out preventive maintenance inspections on vehicle electrical systems
Assist in training and mentoring junior Auto Electricians and workshop personnel
Maintain tools, equipment, and work areas in good condition
